name: a file's modification time arrives on the other device as written, and nothing is sent back
description: KOOFR-003 (Koofr desktop before June 2020): downloaded copies got the download time, breaking mtime-based change detection and backup tools. Rules P6 and P12: modification times travel and are set on downloads, and setting them sends nothing again. sync-chaos port-mtime-roundtrip.
pending: an encrypted drive keeps no file's modification time: a drive synced by name has no way to send one (Drive::put takes none) and lists only the upload's second (ObjectInfo.modified), so the named sync sets mtime_ns 0 and a download gets the download time. It needs a time in the put calls, the pointer and the listing (P6/P12 on encrypted drives)
